name: Add-on Menu
description:
## What it does

Adds one Add-ons button inside the game. Lists your installed add-ons and lets you open their windows or atlas overlays without remembering shortcuts. Add-on Menu appears first in its own list.

## How to use

1. Install and enable Add-on Menu in Studio.
2. Launch your normal game client and enter a character.
3. Click Add-ons near the top-left of the game screen, above the Pocket Wiki button.
4. Choose an add-on and click Open. Boss Atlas and Atlas Legend use Open atlas. Use Previous and Next if there are more entries.

## Shortcuts

No keyboard shortcut is required: click Add-ons. Your existing add-on shortcuts continue to work. Escape or the close button closes the menu.

## Settings

There are no extra settings. Enable, disable or remove this add-on through Studio > Installed add-ons. Close the client before applying changes, then launch it again.

## Good to know

Disabled add-ons are listed but cannot be opened until enabled in Studio. Add-ons with no window run automatically; failed add-ons are marked unavailable. Studio can be closed while playing. Removing Add-on Menu leaves the other add-ons installed and their existing opening controls available.
author: Add-on Hub contributors
release_notes: First Add-on Menu: one in-game launcher, installed add-on list, window and atlas actions, disabled/unavailable states and paging. Native UI smoke checks are separate from interactive gameplay.
